research_question: How are different classes of known variable stars distributed in the Gaia Galactic Colour-Absolute Magnitude Diagram (CaMD)?

phase_1.user_prompt: In order to map empirical instability strips in the Gaia Colour-Absolute Magnitude Diagram (CaMD), we need to cross-match Gaia sources against known variable stars from external literature. Identify the VizieR catalog designations for the two foundational reference datasets we will use: the AAVSO International Variable Star Index, and the main ESA 1997 Hipparcos catalog.

phase_2.user_prompt: Using the identified VizieR catalogs for VSX (`B/vsx/vsx`) and Hipparcos (`I/239/hip_main`), retrieve the coordinates and variability classifications for all known ZZ Ceti stars (type 'ZZ' in VSX) to prepare a reference sample that maps onto the white dwarf sequence in the CaMD.
